text: Hello, Diego? I'm Tanya, the Chief Officer. Can I come in?
Yes, of course. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too. OK, your safety kit. First, your lifejacket. Where is it?
Er… on the wardrobe?
Not on the wardrobe. In the wardrobe. Look, here, on the top shelf.
In the wardrobe. Got it.
And this orange bag, under the bunk, is your immersion suit.
Sorry, can you say that again? Immersion…?
Immersion suit. For cold water. Now, behind the door, there's your muster card. Read it to me.
Muster station B. Boat deck, port side. Lifeboat number two.
Good. And your escape route is the stairs next to the laundry. Not the lift.
The stairs next to the laundry. OK.
Perfect. Tomorrow morning we have a drill. See you at your muster station.
Thank you. See you tomorrow.
Show me your lifejacket.
Where's the immersion suit?
Where's your muster card?
Show me the porthole.
Show me the escape route.
Where's the bunk?
Diego, where's your lifejacket?
And the immersion suit?
Hey Diego, where's your muster card?
Where's your muster station?
My muster station is C. Boat deck, starboard side.
